name: ATM Security Configuration 1
definition: Configuration parameters in use by the security device.

Encryption.name: Encryption
Encryption.definition: Configuration of the encryption or digital envelope, if the security module is able to perform encryption.

MACAlgorithm.name: MAC Algorithm
MACAlgorithm.definition: MAC (Message Authentication Code) algorithm the security module is able to manage.

DigestAlgorithm.name: Digest Algorithm
DigestAlgorithm.definition: Digest algorithm the security module is able to manage.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Configuration of the digital signatures if the security module is able to perform digital signatures with an asymmetric key.

PIN.name: PIN
PIN.definition: Configuration of the PIN online verification.

MessageProtection.name: Message Protection
MessageProtection.definition: Mechanism used to protect the message of the ATM protocol.
